en.headline: Two brothers found dead in Lei Tung Estate flat; no foul play suspected
en.dek: Police say the bodies of men aged 55 and 53 were discovered after a security guard reported a foul smell; post-mortems are pending and the case is treated as discovery of bodies.
body: Police are investigating the discovery of two brothers found dead in a public housing flat at Tung Yip House, Lei Tung Estate in Ap Lei Chau, with no suspicious circumstances identified at this stage.

A security guard alerted authorities around 2.32pm on Monday after noticing an unusual odour from the unit. Officers and firefighters forced entry and paramedics confirmed both men were dead at the scene. The elder sister of the pair had also been contacted after the guard’s report.

The men, surnamed Leung and aged 55 and 53, had shared the flat since 2003. Sources indicated the older brother had long avoided social contact, including with parents and his sister for about a decade, and depended on his younger brother for care. Investigators believe the younger man may have died several weeks earlier, after which the elder could not manage alone.

The older brother’s body was found in the toilet and the younger man’s on a bed in a room. No suicide note was found. The case is being handled by the Aberdeen Police District as discovery of bodies pending post-mortem examinations.

zh.headline: 利東邨單位發現兩兄弟遺體 初步無疑點
zh.dek: 東業樓保安周一報單位傳異味，警消破門發現55歲及53歲兄弟已死，案件列屍體發現，死因有待驗屍。
body: 警方正調查鴨脷洲利東邨東業樓一個單位發現兩名兄弟遺體的案件，初步認為事件無疑點。
周一約下午2時32分，保安員發現單位傳出異味後報警，並聯絡到死者長姊。警員及消防員破門入內，救護員證實兩名男子已死亡。
兩名死者姓梁，分別55歲及53歲，自2003年起同住該單位。消息指兄長長期迴避社交，約十年未與父母及胞姊見面，依靠弟弟照顧。調查人員相信弟弟可能數周前已離世，其後兄長無法自理。
兄長遺體在廁所發現，弟弟則在房間床上。現場未發現遺書。案件由香港仔警區雜項調查隊以屍體發現跟進，死因有待驗屍確定。
